[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
Unfortunately, I'm not able to reproduce this error. The game loads fine with me, even with Cobblemon installed as well as listed in your crash log. Are you able to just load Curios 9.4.2 by itself? If so, I'll need a more narrow list of mods to help track down the error. If you can, you can try having Curios 9.4.2 installed on its own and then add back your mods in batches until you can isolate the probable conflicts.

will try tho it crashes for me on 9.4.2 which is odd but will try

ok so it was curios but a fork mod of this mod that broke the 9.4.2 version i removed it and 9.4.2 works now thank you
